verdicts.reason: The two are almost pixel-identical, so neither is the better resize. Both share the same flaws. The lilac circle moved from behind the product to behind the headline, which weakens the link between the circle and the product. '20% off' runs almost to the right edge. The CTA is jammed tight under the subhead. The product floats in a large empty middle area. 'Ends Sunday' fine print is oversized and sits low near the bottom edge.
